nui 1
const Unit: number = 29
const Delta: number = 11
const Ticks: number[] = [1,2]
for Tick in @Ticks carry Total: number = 9 carry Values: number[] = [29, 40] {
point Incoming = coordinate(x: @Values[0], y: @Total)
point Indexed = coordinate(x: @Values[1], y: @Tick)
const Mapped: number[] = for Item in @Values { if (@Tick > 0) { @Item + @Total + @Tick } else { 1 / 0 } }
next Total = if (@Tick > 0) { @Total + @Values[1] + @Tick } else { 1 / 0 }
next Values = @Mapped
}
const Final0: number = @Values[0]
const Final1: number = @Values[1]
const FinalTotal: number = @Total
point Final = coordinate(x: @Final0, y: @FinalTotal)
